sentences.text: The type specimen of Nominosuchus is a partial skull identified as PIN 4174/4, measuring about 60 mm in length.
The genus Nominosuchus was described by Mikhail Efimov in 1996.
This animal is classified as a protosuchian-grade crocodyliform and belongs to the family Shartegosuchidae, which serves as its parent group. The type species of the genus is N. matutinus.
